_comment: Hazard classes as data (architecture §2 EVENTS: 'new event types are data, not code').
Adding one needs no Python. Order is load-bearing: it fixes the sequence of keyed
draws in hazards.sample_day, and so the determinism hash.
p_per_day is ABSOLUTE, not per-capita — the same 0.25 hazards a day whether the
world holds 306 people or 49,578. Held against population that is 298 per 1,000
per year at 306 and 1.84 at 49,578, so the values below are tuned for narrative
density in a small world and are NOT calibrated to Pune. The architecture names
NCRB city tables as the source; none is vendored yet. See docs/soaks/v3-scale-soak.md.
narratability (08-identity §5): full = a scene may open on it; abstract = it may be
referred to but not staged; numeric = it happens and is counted, and no scene ever
